blurb: Blaze Yoga & Fitness offers a variety of yoga, fitness, strength training, and mobility classes in a heated studio. Classes are designed for all levels, from beginners to advanced, with instructors providing modifications. They also offer a restorative retreat on Monhegan Island with yoga, hiking, and community activities.
